qs.q: A scientist measures intracellular pH regulation in an actively respiring cell. Which membrane transporter plays the primary role in extruding excess intracellular acid equivalents?
o: ATP-driven proton pump moving hydrogen ions into cytoplasm
Chloride-bicarbonate exchanger bringing bicarbonate out of cells
Sodium-hydrogen exchanger moving protons out against gradient
Sodium-calcium exchanger carrying protons as a side function
qs.e: The sodium-hydrogen exchanger uses the sodium gradient to extrude intracellular protons and maintain cytoplasmic pH.
qs.s: Weekly Year 1: Physiology Exam - October 30, 2026 (Section A: MCQs)

qs.q: Which hormone promotes sodium reabsorption and can indirectly influence pH regulation?
qs.e: ** Aldosterone promotes reabsorption of sodium and bicarbonate ions in the kidneys, leading to increased blood pH and indirectly influencing acid-base regulation.
